semantics.clock: Positive edge, per original sequential logic requirement
semantics.reset: Active-low synchronous; when sampled low clear all four flops to zero
semantics.transition: On each non-reset rising edge: stage1 captures in; stage2 captures previous stage1; stage3 captures previous stage2; stage4 captures previous stage3; out is stage4
semantics.latency: An input sampled on edge N appears after edge N+3 (four capturing flops)
semantics.initialization: No initial value specified; no DUT initialization; functional checks begin after synchronous reset
semantics.between_edges: Output holds, including when resetn changes between rising edges

verification.oracle: Independent four-element history updated on rising edges from original shift register description
verification.sampling: Check after nonblocking updates; also check before rising edge and at falling edge
cases: reset asserted away from rising edges
verification.pass: Fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only after completed checks

specification_ambiguities.resolution: Interpret resettable D flops as clearing all stages to zero.
No initialization guarantee or pre-reset known-value assertion.
